facts.text: the absurd fancy dinner with the tiny plates and Keanu
facts.why: The disastrous double date with Keanu Reeves is real. None of the pages read mention tiny plates.
facts.fix: the awful fancy double date with Keanu

facts.text: Spam fried rice with a runny egg
facts.why: The film shows fried Spam over white rice with furikake. No fried rice or runny egg is described.
facts.fix: Fried Spam over rice with furikake

facts.text: Serve the mains when Sasha cooks the kimchi stew Marcus's mum taught her.
facts.why: Marcus's mum Judy cooks the stew, and young Sasha helps. The grown-up Sasha is not the one cooking.
facts.fix: Serve the mains when young Sasha helps Marcus's mum make the kimchi stew.

vibe.verdict: A warm San Francisco family kitchen that gets Keanu, Hello Peril and the stew, with three small slips in who cooks what.
missing: Judy's 'That's when I learned to start with the thing that can fly away.' (the kimchi stew scene)
The Burger King cashier line (Marcus's order)
Keanu's doomed tiny plates at Sasha's restaurant date (the double date)
Marcus's goodbye note and the stew left behind
ideas: Swap the Marcus note on the venue card for Judy's line about starting with the thing that can fly away.
Swap 'Roasted barley tea' note for the Burger King cashier line.
Swap 'Chilled peach soju' note for a line about Keanu's dinner.
Swap 'Sasha's miso-glazed salmon rice bowls' note for 'Sasha's fusion menu, as far from the stew as it gets'.
